Bureaucratic obstruction stems from entrenched institutional self-preservation.

Public awareness of classified information requires top-down political courage.
Political loyalty to President Trump correlates with commitment to transparency on UAPs.
Military and intelligence agencies contain deep-rooted corruption that undermines national security.
Business experience provides superior governance compared to traditional political careers.
Cutting government programs will lead to significant fiscal savings without major societal harm.
The speaker views the federal bureaucracy as fundamentally dysfunctional and resistant to reform.
Prayer serves as a legitimate and expected civic act for national recovery.
